name: Triple Plane (TP) Decomposition
aliases: CP decomposition variant using 2D factor matrices
definition: A variant of CP decomposition that uses 2D factor matrices (planes) instead of 1D vectors to factorize a 3D scene tensor, trading storage compactness for computational efficiency and better quality with smaller ranks.
summary: Triple Plane Decomposition is a tensor factorization method that replaces 1D vectors with 2D planes to improve representation quality and computational efficiency for complex 3D scenes.
